titulo: Tax Shielding with Former SUNAT Tax Auditor Criteria
parrafo_1: Estudio Cusihuaman was founded with the mission to defend and protect independent professionals and workers from improper tax assessments and penalties from the tax authority.
parrafo_2: Led by Lourdes Cusihuaman Gálvez, former SUNAT tax officer and specialist in employment income taxes (4th and 5th categories), we bring deep insider knowledge of tax audit criteria, ITF banking cross-checks, and administrative defense procedures to guarantee complete peace of mind.
